user.title: Add a Smart Listening agent
user.description: Voice PE devices with the Smart Listening firmware start a request whenever they hear speech. This agent decides which speech is meant for the assistant and passes only that on.

data_description.target_agent: The agent that answers accepted requests, for example your LLM or Assist agent.
data_description.assistant_names: Names the assistant answers to, separated by commas. The first is the main name.
data_description.classifier: How overheard speech is judged when it contains the name or follows a reply.

data_description.classifier_url: Clef: the full decision endpoint, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080/v1/systemone. Jev: leave as is. OpenAI-compatible: the base URL, for example http://192.168.1.20:11434/v1.
data_description.classifier_model: Model name as the server knows it. Self-hosted Clef: clef, or the name your server uses (Cloudflare/clef on SGLang). Clef on Cloudflare: clef, or clef-flash for the smaller, cheaper model. Jev: a pinned version such as jev-1.14.0 keeps answers stable; jev-latest changes with each release.
data_description.classifier_api_key: Jev: the key from the TypeSafe console. Clef on Cloudflare: an API token with Workers AI permission. Leave empty for local servers that do not need one.
data_description.cloudflare_account_id: Clef on Cloudflare: your account ID, shown in the Cloudflare dashboard under Workers AI.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the classifier. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.target_is_self: Choose a different agent: a Smart Listening agent cannot pass requests to itself.

data.wake_word_threshold: Request threshold when the wake word was heard

data_description.target_agent: The agent that answers accepted requests.
data_description.backup_agent: Optional. Answers when the main agent is missing, fails, times out or reports a server error. Leave empty to say that the assistant isn't available instead.
data_description.agent_timeout: How long an agent may take to answer before it counts as failed.
data_description.address_threshold: How sure the classifier must be that speech containing the name is a request. Higher means fewer false replies and more missed requests.
data_description.wake_word_threshold: Used instead when the device's wake word model also heard the name.
data_description.followup_threshold: How sure the classifier must be that speech after a reply, without the name, continues the conversation.
data_description.followup_seconds: How long after a reply speech without the name is checked as a follow-up. 0 turns follow-ups off.
data_description.keep_listening: The Voice PE listens again straight after each answer, so you can carry on without the name. What it hears is judged as a follow-up; side talk is dropped. Off: it only keeps listening when the agent asks a question.
data_description.name_pause: When the name is said on its own ("Lorelai..."), the Voice PE greets after this much silence instead of waiting for Home Assistant to decide you have stopped speaking. Needs the Smart Listening firmware with "Name pause"; set on each Voice PE that uses this assistant. 0 turns it off.
data_description.reply_script: Optional. If your Voice PEs send replies to a room speaker through a script, choose it here so the greeting ("Hi, how can I help?") plays there too. It is called with url and satellite (the Voice PE's ESPHome name).
data_description.handle_timers: Start, cancel, change and check timers on the Voice PE that heard the request, without the conversation agent. Needs a classifier. English only.
data_description.timer_threshold: How sure the classifier must be that a request is a timer command. Below this, or for reminders, the request goes to the conversation agent.
data_description.decision_log: Write every decision and its transcript to smart_listening/decisions.jsonl in the config folder. This records what people in the home say.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the classifier. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.target_is_self: Choose a different agent: a Smart Listening agent cannot pass requests to itself.
error.backup_is_self: Choose a different agent: a Smart Listening agent cannot be its own backup.

options.clef_cloud: Clef on Cloudflare Workers AI (needs an account ID and API token)
options.jev: Jev (TypeSafe's hosted System One model, needs an API key)
options.openai: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio or a cloud API)
options.name_only: Name only (no classifier: answer when the name is among the first words)

agent_unavailable.title: {assistant}: {agent} isn't answering
agent_unavailable.description:
Smart Listening could not reach {agent}, the conversation agent for {assistant}. It may be missing, failing or timing out.

Until it answers, accepted requests go to the backup conversation agent if one is set in the Smart Listening options. Otherwise the assistant says it isn't available.

This message goes away by itself the next time {agent} answers. The decision log and the Home Assistant log show the error.

classifier_unavailable.title: {assistant}: the Smart Listening classifier isn't answering
classifier_unavailable.description:
The classifier that decides which speech is meant for {assistant} has failed several times in a row.

Until it answers, speech is answered only when the assistant's name is among its first few words, and follow-ups without the name are not answered.

Check that the classifier server is running and reachable. This message goes away by itself the next time the classifier answers.
